data.long_meaning: The name Abby is derived from the Hebrew name 'Abba', which means 'father'. In the New Testament, Abba is used as an Aramaic term of endearment for God, meaning 'father'. The name Abby therefore signifies joy or happiness in the presence of God. The name Abby carries the meaning “Father of joy” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Abby usually hope their child will grow to embody father of joy and live with faith, good character and purpose.
